Job Description:
As an ASIC Verification Engineering Intern in the Data Center Solutions group (DCS), you will work on developing and validating our next generation Data Center Storage products, including enterprise class NVMe SSD controllers and other PCIe-based products. This will involve verification at the IP level/subsystem or SOC level. You will be mentored and coached by experienced engineers and be exposed to Microchip's Best-In-Class engineering practices.
Job Responsibilities:
Ramping up on storage-related technical knowledge/concepts: ARM, AXI, PCIe, NVMe, DDR, NAND Flash, DMA, encryption, and so on.
Learning through practice of verification methodologies.
Working under guidance of the technical lead.
Working in the SOC verification environment to debug and root-cause failures in SOC.
Writing Embedded C programming code and run testcases.
Verification environment using UVM testbench.
Run and develop Python/TCL/Shell verification scripts to test the SOC verification.
Requirements/Qualifications:
Actively pursuing a BS degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering, MS degree preferred
Courses in digital design, computer architecture and C programming is a must
Proficient in Verilog/SystemVerilog, C programming, TCL/Python/Shell Scripting
Excellent analytical, programming, debugging and scripting skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Ability to work independently and in a team environment
Experience with simulation, UVM and simulation tools a plus
